tex_content.html:
Lemma
[the $s$-derivative of the energy density, chart-free]

↗ lem:dc-ch9-2-covariant-pair-leibniz ↗ def:dc-ch9-2-covariant-pair

1. ch9:2.4Let $V$ be a vector field along a curve $\gamma $ with covariant derivative $DV$ in the sense of section 1. Then, at interior times, \[ \frac{d}{dt}\langle V,V\rangle = 2\Big\langle \frac{DV}{dt},V\Big\rangle . \]

Applied along a transversal $\sigma \mapsto f(\sigma ,t)$ of a variation (section 1) with $V=\frac{\partial f}{\partial t}$, this is the first equality of section 1 with the chart removed: a transversal is a curve like any other, and section 1 is chart-independent.
Proof

↗ lem:dc-ch9-2-covariant-pair-leibniz \sketch By section 1 at $W=V$, one has $\frac{d}{dt}\langle V,V\rangle =\langle \frac{DV}{dt},V\rangle +\langle V,\frac{DV}{dt}\rangle $ at interior times. The two summands are equal by the symmetry of the metric, which supplies the factor $2$.

□
